summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Cozy Box Phase 1. 15/15 pytest API tests pass. All UI testids exercised: age-gate, hero CTAs, header nav (6 links), menu tabs (food/drink), Cellar add-to-cart -> cart drawer -> checkout Phase-2 notice, booking flow (date->slots->submit->success), contact submit success, private/events enquiry submit success, What's On events, Our Story, Passport plans. No uncaught page errors. Only console warnings are the documented React Router v7 future-flag warnings + a Lenis 'non-static container' warning (cosmetic).

issues: Lenis warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute, to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Repeats on every route. Cosmetic but should be silenced by adding position:relative to the Lenis wrapper element.

action_items: (Low-prio cosmetic) Add position:relative (or fixed/absolute) to the Lenis wrapper to silence repeated console warning.
(Optional) Adopt React Router v7 future flags (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) to remove deprecation warnings — explicitly noted as acceptable in the request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: catalog endpoint returns full list with no pagination; fine for 21 items today but consider limit/skip before adding more data.
Mongo writes use .insert_one but inserted doc is mutated by Motor (adds _id). _save correctly strips _id before returning — good. Confirm callers never reuse the returned dict to insert again.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_methods/headers='*' is fine for Phase 1 demo but should be tightened before production (restrict to the public domain).
No rate limiting on POST /contact, /bookings, /packages/enquiries — public, unauthenticated write endpoints. Add basic IP throttling (slowapi/fastapi-limiter) before launch.
BookingIn.date/time are plain strings without format validation. Accepts '2026-13-99' / 'banana'. Consider date/time pydantic types or regex validators.
Frontend body has cursor:none (custom SpotlightCursor). Verify accessibility — keyboard users / touch devices fall back gracefully; appears to (touch wins on mobile).
Lenis warning recurring on every route — cheap fix: ensure html or main wrapper has position:relative.
test_credentials: None — public site, no auth. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present (not applicable for this app).
seed_data_creation: Test inserts 1 contact_messages, 1 bookings, 1 package_enquiries doc per test run (prefixed TEST_ in name field). No cleanup performed — volume is negligible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend lives at /app/backend/server.py with content in content.py. Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_cozybox_api.py covers every documented API. Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll + age gate (data-testid=age-gate-yes) that must be clicked first on every fresh session. All interactive elements have data-testids matching the request. Square is intentionally mocked — checkout shows data-testid='checkout-notice' instead of charging.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified. The only non-blocking observation is a repeated Lenis console warning about a non-static positioned container — purely cosmetic, no functional impact.
